# Hear See Do

Hear See Do is a Confidence First Learning education initiative founded in 2015 in Nagoya, Japan. Its approach is Hear it / See it / Do it. Educational books include Monkey Yoga Phonics and Monkeys Talk & Unlock.

Address: Ultimate Meieki 1st, 2F, 3-4-10 Meieki, Nakamura-ku, Nagoya 450-0002, Japan (near Nagoya Station / 名古屋駅近く).
Contact: hearseedo.english@gmail.com
Website: https://www.hearseedo.jp/
